## Check Candidates Against the Whole Clue
Before answering, test a candidate against every defining descriptor and relationship in the clue; matching one salient word or a nearby fact is not enough.

## Use Evidence Context Carefully
A snippet that repeats the clue can be a useful anchor, but check its nearby context to find the answer rather than treating the repeated clue text as the answer. Cor

## Follow the Output Format
Honor the requested final-answer format exactly, including required tags, structure, or labels. Keep analysis and unrequested explanation out of the final answer.
